cards.scene_sentence: If I were omnipotent for a day, I would want world peace.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 如果我有一天无所不能，我会希望世界和平。
cards.everyday_example: The CEO is powerful, but not omnipotent.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 首席执行官权力很大，但并非无所不能。

cards.scene_sentence: I thought it was a theoretical question.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我以为那只是个假设性问题。
cards.everyday_example: It's a theoretical question, not a proposal.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 这只是理论问题，不是提议。

cards.scene_sentence: You just nodded off again.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你刚才又睡着了。
cards.everyday_example: I nodded off on the train home.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我在回家的火车上打了个盹。

cards.scene_sentence: They reassure each other that they're having a good time.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 他们互相确认彼此都很享受。
cards.everyday_example: She reassured me that the deadline was flexible.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 她向我保证截止时间可以调整。

cards.scene_sentence: You got way too much free time, man.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你的空闲时间也太多了。
cards.everyday_example: I spent way too much time on that detail.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我在那个细节上花了太多时间。

cards.scene_sentence: I better pass on the game.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我还是不去看比赛了。
cards.everyday_example: Thanks, but I'll pass on dessert.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 谢谢，不过甜点我就不吃了。

cards.definition_zh: 使我暂时不再想烦心事
cards.scene_sentence: Maybe it will take my mind off it.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 也许这能让我暂时不想那件事。
cards.everyday_example: A walk might take your mind off work.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 散步也许能让你暂时忘掉工作。

cards.definition_zh: 发誓；强调自己所说属实
cards.scene_sentence: I swear I've seen birds do this on Wild Kingdom.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我发誓我在《野生王国》里见过鸟这么做。
cards.everyday_example: I swear I left the keys on the desk.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我发誓我把钥匙放在桌上了。

cards.scene_sentence: I earned this.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 这是我自己挣来的。
cards.everyday_example: She earned her first paycheck last month.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 她上个月挣到了第一份工资。

cards.scene_sentence: And it was totally not worth it.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 而且完全不值得。
cards.everyday_example: The long commute just isn't worth it.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 这么长时间通勤实在不值得。

cards.scene_sentence: You're fine, yeah, for a first job.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 作为第一份工作，你这还算不错。
cards.everyday_example: The salary is decent for a first job.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 作为第一份工作，这份薪水还不错。

cards.scene_sentence: Kiki, you look phenomenal.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 琪琪，你看起来棒极了。
cards.everyday_example: The response to the launch was phenomenal.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 产品发布后的反响非常惊人。

cards.scene_sentence: Guess who my dad's making partner in his firm?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 猜猜我爸要提拔谁做事务所合伙人？
cards.everyday_example: The firm made her partner after eight years.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 八年后，事务所提拔她为合伙人。

cards.scene_sentence: And while we're on the subject of news.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 既然我们谈到新闻。
cards.everyday_example: While we're on the subject, can we discuss the budget?
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 既然说到这里，我们能谈谈预算吗？

cards.definition_zh: 把东西传上去；放弃机会
cards.scene_sentence: Passes it up to Leetch.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 他把球传给利奇。
cards.everyday_example: I couldn't pass up such a good opportunity.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我无法放弃这么好的机会。

cards.scene_sentence: We'll take a time-out while Messier looks at some women's shoes.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 梅西耶看女鞋时，我们先暂停一下。
cards.everyday_example: Let's take a time-out and review the facts.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我们暂停一下，重新看看事实。

cards.scene_sentence: She never took them off.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 她从来没有脱掉它们。
cards.everyday_example: Please take off your shoes at the door.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 请在门口脱鞋。

cards.scene_sentence: And I take the dead flowers out of the vase.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我还会把枯花从花瓶里拿走。
cards.everyday_example: Take the charger out of your bag.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 把充电器从包里拿出来。

cards.scene_sentence: The biggest news is still you dumping Barry at the altar.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 最大的新闻仍然是你在婚礼现场甩掉巴瑞。
cards.everyday_example: The film begins with the hero being dumped at the altar.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 电影开头男主角在婚礼现场被甩了。

cards.scene_sentence: Let's talk reality for a second.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我们认真谈一下现实吧。
cards.everyday_example: Let's talk reality: we can't finish this today.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 说现实一点：我们今天做不完。

cards.scene_sentence: I even do my own laundry.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我甚至自己洗衣服。
cards.everyday_example: Living alone taught me to do my own laundry.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 独居让我学会自己洗衣服。

cards.scene_sentence: Could you please tell me what this is in reference to?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 请问这件事是关于什么的？
cards.everyday_example: I'm calling in reference to your application.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我打电话是关于你的申请。

cards.definition_zh: 异常活动，尤其指账户活动
cards.scene_sentence: There's been unusual activity on your account.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你的账户出现了异常活动。
cards.everyday_example: The bank flagged unusual activity on my card.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 银行标记了我卡上的异常活动。

cards.scene_sentence: Everyone is getting married or pregnant or promoted.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 每个人不是结婚、怀孕，就是升职。
cards.everyday_example: She got promoted after leading the project.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 她领导项目后获得了晋升。

cards.scene_sentence: I gave up, like, everything.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我几乎放弃了一切。
cards.everyday_example: He gave up everything to start over abroad.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 他放弃一切，到国外重新开始。

cards.scene_sentence: Everything was figured out.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 一切都安排明白了。
cards.everyday_example: We need to figure out what went wrong.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我们需要弄清哪里出了问题。

cards.scene_sentence: It's all gonna come together.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 一切最终都会顺利的。
cards.everyday_example: The plan is finally coming together.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 这个计划终于开始成形了。

cards.scene_sentence: I didn't mean to bring you down.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我不是故意让你们扫兴的。
cards.everyday_example: Don't let one bad review bring you down.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 别让一条差评影响你的情绪。

cards.scene_sentence: I'm not completely satisfied.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我并不完全满意。
cards.everyday_example: Are you satisfied with the final draft?
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 你对最终稿满意吗？

cards.scene_sentence: Or we'd be in the predicament room.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 不然我们就该在困境室了。
cards.everyday_example: I understand your predicament, but we need a decision.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我理解你的困境，但我们需要决定。

cards.scene_sentence: Any minute now.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 随时都会到。
cards.everyday_example: The package should arrive any minute now.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 包裹随时会送到。

cards.scene_sentence: And then he woke up and there was this big plant outside of his window.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 然后他醒来，发现窗外长着一棵巨大的植物。
cards.everyday_example: I woke up before the alarm went off.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 闹钟响之前我就醒了。

cards.scene_sentence: I don't have a plan.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我没有计划。
cards.everyday_example: You don't need every answer, but you need a plan.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 你不必知道所有答案，但需要一个计划。

cards.scene_sentence: What if all we've got are beans?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 如果我们拥有的只有豆子呢？
cards.everyday_example: This old laptop is all we've got for now.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 这台旧笔记本是我们现在仅有的设备。

cards.scene_sentence: Bonehead!
cards.scene_translation_zh: 笨蛋！
cards.everyday_example: I felt like a bonehead after missing the obvious typo.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 漏掉那个明显的错字后，我觉得自己像个笨蛋。

cards.scene_sentence: You guys want me to take this back?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 你们想让我把这个送回去吗？
cards.everyday_example: This shirt doesn't fit, so I'll take it back.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 这件衬衫不合身，我会拿去退。

cards.scene_sentence: Who are we spying on?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我们在偷看谁？
cards.everyday_example: It's wrong to spy on your coworkers.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 暗中监视同事是不对的。

cards.scene_sentence: White House adviser, Clinton's campaign guy.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 白宫顾问，克林顿竞选团队的人。
cards.everyday_example: She used to be a campaign strategist.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 她曾经是一名竞选策略师。

cards.scene_sentence: We're gonna get in trouble.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我们会惹上麻烦的。
cards.everyday_example: You'll get in trouble if you ignore the rules.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 无视规则会让你惹上麻烦。

cards.scene_sentence: I think you have to draw him out.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我觉得你得引导他多说一点。
cards.everyday_example: A good interviewer knows how to draw people out.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 好的采访者懂得如何引导别人开口。

cards.scene_sentence: He was really tender.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 他当时非常温柔。
cards.everyday_example: She gave the child a tender smile.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 她温柔地对孩子微笑。

cards.scene_sentence: Chandler's one of those repressed guys.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 钱德勒是那种压抑自己的人。
cards.everyday_example: He grew up in an emotionally repressed family.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 他在一个压抑情感的家庭中长大。

cards.scene_sentence: Chandler is more sophisticated than he seems.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 钱德勒比看起来更成熟老练。
cards.everyday_example: The software uses a sophisticated ranking model.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 这个软件采用复杂的排序模型。

cards.scene_sentence: I think it's an act.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 我觉得那是装的。
cards.everyday_example: His confidence is partly an act.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 他的自信有一部分是装出来的。

cards.scene_sentence: Could I get some painkillers over here, please?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 可以给我些止痛药吗？
cards.everyday_example: The doctor prescribed a mild painkiller.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 医生开了一种温和的止痛药。

cards.scene_sentence: What's the big deal about today?
cards.scene_translation_zh: 今天有什么大不了的？
cards.everyday_example: It's a small delay; what's the big deal?
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 只是小小延期，有什么大不了的？

cards.scene_sentence: It's a little more complicated.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 事情要复杂一点。
cards.everyday_example: The tax rules are more complicated than they look.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 税务规则比看起来更复杂。

cards.scene_sentence: There's a bunch of stuff we could've done tonight.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 今晚我们本来有很多事可以做。
cards.everyday_example: I have a bunch of emails to answer.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 我有一堆邮件要回复。

cards.scene_sentence: Admit it, all things considered, you had fun tonight.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 承认吧，综合来看你今晚玩得挺开心。
cards.everyday_example: All things considered, the launch went well.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 综合来看，这次发布很顺利。

cards.definition_zh: 谁捡到归谁，丢的人只能认倒霉
cards.scene_sentence: Finders keepers, losers weepers.
cards.scene_translation_zh: 谁捡到就是谁的，丢的人只能哭。
cards.everyday_example: He joked, 'Finders keepers,' when he found the coin.
cards.everyday_translation_zh: 他捡到硬币时开玩笑说“谁捡到归谁”。
